learning_outcomes.text: Explain calls, puts, strikes, expiration and moneyness
Distinguish intrinsic value from time value in an option price
Describe how the primary Greeks affect an option's price
Explain how implied volatility influences premiums
Apply core single-leg strategies and their risk profiles
Describe simple vertical spreads and assignment risk

integrative_case: A stock investor wants to learn options: define a call and a put with strike and expiration, split a premium into intrinsic and time value, see how the Greeks and volatility move the price, and build a covered call and a bull call spread with their risk labelled.
